mapper.select: SELECT cr.room_id AS roomId, cr.status AS status, cr.latest_message AS latestMessage, cr.latest_at AS latestAt, ts.end_time AS expiresAt, t.title AS trainingTitle, CASE WHEN #{userId} = cr.user_id THEN trainer.username ELSE trainee.username END AS opponentName, CASE WHEN #{userId} = cr.user_id THEN trainer.user_profile_url ELSE trainee.user_profile_url END AS opponentProfileUrl FROM counseling_reservations cr LEFT JOIN trainer_schedules ts ON cr.schedule_id = ts.schedule_id JOIN users trainee ON trainee.user_id = cr.user_id JOIN users trainer ON trainer.user_id = cr.trainer_id JOIN trainings t ON t.training_id = cr.training_id WHERE #{userId} IN (cr.user_id, cr.trainer_id) AND cr.user_id <> cr.trainer_id ORDER BY cr.latest_at DESC

SELECT reservation_id, user_id as traineeId, trainer_id as trainerId, training_id as trainingId, schedule_id as scheduleId, status, room_id as roomId, latest_message as latestMessage, latest_at as latestAt, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM counseling_reservations WHERE user_id = #{traineeId} AND trainer_id = #{trainerId} AND status IN ('예약완료', '진행중') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO counseling_reservations (user_id, trainer_id, training_id, schedule_id, status, room_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{traineeId}, #{trainerId}, #{trainingId}, #{scheduleId}, #{status}, #{roomId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT reservation_id as reservationId, user_id as traineeId, trainer_id as trainerId, training_id as trainingId, schedule_id as scheduleId, status, room_id as roomId, latest_message as latestMessage, latest_at as latestAt, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM counseling_reservations WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId}

SELECT cr.reservation_id, cr.user_id as trainee_id, cr.trainer_id, cr.training_id, cr.schedule_id, cr.status, cr.room_id, ts.start_time, ts.end_time, trainer.username AS trainer_name, trainee.username AS trainee_name, t.title AS training_title, cr.created_at FROM counseling_reservations cr JOIN trainer_schedules ts ON cr.schedule_id = ts.schedule_id JOIN users trainer ON cr.trainer_id = trainer.user_id JOIN users trainee ON cr.user_id = trainee.user_id JOIN trainings t ON cr.training_id = t.training_id WHERE cr.user_id = #{traineeId} ORDER BY ts.start_time DESC

SELECT cr.reservation_id, cr.user_id as trainee_id, cr.trainer_id, cr.training_id, cr.schedule_id, cr.status, cr.room_id, ts.start_time, ts.end_time, trainer.username AS trainer_name, trainee.username AS trainee_name, t.title AS training_title, cr.created_at FROM counseling_reservations cr JOIN trainer_schedules ts ON cr.schedule_id = ts.schedule_id JOIN users trainer ON cr.trainer_id = trainer.user_id JOIN users trainee ON cr.user_id = trainee.user_id JOIN trainings t ON cr.training_id = t.training_id WHERE cr.trainer_id = #{trainerId} ORDER BY ts.start_time DESC

SELECT reservation_id as reservationId, user_id as traineeId, trainer_id as trainerId, training_id as trainingId, schedule_id as scheduleId, status, room_id as roomId, latest_message as latestMessage, latest_at as latestAt, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM counseling_reservations WHERE room_id = #{roomId}

SELECT cr.reservation_id as reservationId, cr.user_id as traineeId, cr.trainer_id as trainerId, cr.training_id as trainingId, cr.schedule_id as scheduleId, cr.status, cr.room_id as roomId, cr.latest_message as latestMessage, cr.latest_at as latestAt, cr.created_at as createdAt, cr.updated_at as updatedAt FROM counseling_reservations cr JOIN trainer_schedules ts ON cr.schedule_id = ts.schedule_id WHERE cr.status = '예약완료' AND ts.start_time <= #{currentTime} AND ts.end_time > #{currentTime}

SELECT cr.reservation_id as reservationId, cr.user_id as traineeId, cr.trainer_id as trainerId, cr.training_id as trainingId, cr.schedule_id as scheduleId, cr.status, cr.room_id as roomId, cr.latest_message as latestMessage, cr.latest_at as latestAt, cr.created_at as createdAt, cr.updated_at as updatedAt FROM counseling_reservations cr JOIN trainer_schedules ts ON cr.schedule_id = ts.schedule_id WHERE cr.status = '진행중' AND ts.end_time <= #{currentTime}
